head: Claude Sheets and Whiteboards: Claude now builds spreadsheets and boards with you
dek: Anthropic added Sheets and Whiteboards to Claude in beta, on all paid plans: Claude builds a spreadsheet or a shared brainstorming board with you and your team. Claude Dashboards is now generally available as Claude Data.
details: Sheets can have tabs, formulas, formatting and drop-downs, made from a prompt like "a hiring budget"; Claude marks each edit so you can follow changes, and you can export to Excel (.xlsx) or CSV. Whiteboards turn a messy plan into a board with owners and dates, then into a doc or deck, or into Miro or Lucid. Claude Data answers questions about company data in tools such as BigQuery, with certified metrics and live sharing in beta.
where: Claude on web, desktop and mobile, paid plans
means: You can keep a spreadsheet or brainstorm inside Claude instead of copying results into another app.
todo: In Claude, ask for a spreadsheet or a board, then share it with your team or export it when you need more spreadsheet features.
